result.note: Draft rules are a concrete government step on road safety; testing the scope, start date and aim of the proposed V2V mandate.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, draft rules on vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication in India were reported. Consider the following statements about them:
items: The V2V requirement would apply only to new commercial vehicles, leaving new private cars exempt.
The requirement would take effect from October 2028 and is aimed at blind-spot crashes.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the draft rules would cover all new vehicles, not only commercial ones. The mandate would start in October 2028 and targets blind-spot crashes, which cause a disproportionate share of road casualties in India.
questions.source: Draft rules would require vehicle-to-vehicle communication in all new vehicles from October 2028, aimed at the blind-spot crashes that cause a disproportionate share of road casualties in the country.
